producer_report.summary: The wait before the landing push now decides only from the candidate's check run named "fmt, clippy, tests". The other jobs' conclusions are ignored. Root cause: the old wait read workflow runs, which cannot name a job, so the candidate's always-failing history and PR-head jobs ended it at once. I added `PrHost::check_run`, which reads `commits/{sha}/check-runs` and takes the highest-id run of that name. All PrHost implementations are updated (the real client, the two test_support fakes, and the gh.rs test hosts). A missing check run, an unreadable reply and the timeout behave as before. The 20 s step and the bound are unchanged. I ran the gh:: tests, clippy and fmt; I did not run the full workspace suite.

checks_run.note: 73 passed, including the two new tests and the parse_check_run test

criteria_check.criterion: A new fake-host test in gh.rs: the candidate has a failed history job and 'fmt, clippy, tests' in progress then completed; land polls (sleeps) until 'fmt, clippy, tests' completes and only then replaces the early head. Run cargo test -p athena-core and see it pass.
criteria_check.evidence: land_pr_waits_for_the_named_check_run_when_the_history_job_failed passes. It scripts a failed 'the full history' job on every look and expects the log check_run, sleep 20, check_run, sleep 20, check_run, replace, with a note saying waited 40s and completed. Run via cargo test -p athena-core --lib gh::.

criteria_check.criterion: A new test: 'fmt, clippy, tests' on the candidate is already failed, with the other jobs in any state; land pushes at once with no sleeping and the note says that job failed. Run cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: land_pr_pushes_at_once_when_the_named_check_run_failed passes. It runs with the other jobs in progress and with them completed, and expects the log [check_run early1, replace] and a note containing 'fmt, clippy, tests failed'.

criteria_check.criterion: Existing early-run tests (waits before pushing, pushes at once when completed, pushes anyway on timeout, unreadable or no runs) still pass, and cargo clippy and cargo fmt --check are clean.
criteria_check.evidence: The existing early-run tests were adapted to script the named job and pass in the gh:: run. Clippy with -D warnings and fmt --check are clean.

criteria_check.criterion: wait_for_early_run no longer ends on any failed workflow run; it decides only from the check run named 'fmt, clippy, tests' (a constant), found through the host seam, and its doc comment says so and why (a candidate is not a landing).
criteria_check.evidence: wait_for_early_run calls job.host.check_run(early_head, EARLY_RUN_JOB) and no longer calls ci_runs. EARLY_RUN_JOB is a const, and the doc comment says why: a candidate is not a landing, so its other jobs always fail there.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the changed wait.
criteria_check.evidence: A new Fixed entry under Unreleased describes waiting only for the candidate's 'fmt, clippy, tests' check run.

open_issues: I did not run the full workspace suite (cargo test --locked); only the gh:: tests and clippy over all targets.
EARLY_RUN_JOB must match the job name in the CI workflow; if the name changes, the wait silently pushes at once, and the note says the check run is missing.
The plan suggested a RunHost helper that adds a failed history job; I added run_state_with_failed_history for it. The failed-job test builds its other jobs inline.
learnings: The ci_runs workflow-run data cannot name a job; the check-runs endpoint can.
RunHost in the gh.rs tests logs the early-commit look with the label check_run early1 (it was ci_runs early1).
